verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no first-party documentation of per-second or usage-based billing for Cloudflare Sandboxes. Community comments cite vCPU prices and a monthly figure 'when used continuously', and mention containers auto-shutting down after idle, but none establishes per-second billing only for compute actually used. The pricing axis applies to a hosted sandbox product, so the lack of evidence yields 'none'.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can pay per second only for the compute a sandbox actually uses
